name: MegaRobotics M100
summary: A heavy-duty walking quadruped of 68 kg that carries 50 kg continuously, rated IP67, sold under the German MegaRobotics brand and built by an OEM partner. Meant for inspection rounds on industrial sites, plants and utility tunnels outside Ex zones.

germany.statusNote: Sold by MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH, Kaarst) as its own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner; "Sourcing on request", "Inquiry only", price on request. The page says CE conformity is in preparation.

sellers.note: "Contact for pricing"; own brand for the DACH region: "MegaRobotics supplies, integrates and services the M100 in the DACH region, built by an OEM manufacturing partner." CE conformity is in preparation.

researchEvidence.quote: IP67 sealing and a −20 to +55 °C operating range suit outdoor sites, tunnels and industrial plants.
It climbs stairs with 20 cm steps, single obstacles up to 30 cm and 45° slopes on high-grip surfaces, and wades through 30 cm of water.
